Compute GC fraction and mappability for fixed genome windows

Source: R/bins.R
compute_bin_mappability.Rd

Compute the per-window GC fraction from a reference FASTA and the per-window mappable fraction from a mappability track (e.g. a GenMap bedGraph). Windows whose coordinates fall outside the reference sequence are retained and get NA GC fraction.

Usage

compute_bin_mappability(
  genome_bins,
  genome_mappability,
  th = 0.8,
  window_prop = 0.7,
  ref_path,
  BPPARAM = BiocParallel::SerialParam(),
  verbose = FALSE
)

Arguments

genome_bins

A GRanges of fixed windows, e.g. from make_fixed_bins().

genome_mappability

A bedGraph file path, or a GRanges with a numeric score metadata column. Importing a file requires rtracklayer.

th

Numeric scalar in (0, 1]. Mappability score threshold.

window_prop

Numeric scalar in [0, 1]. A window is mappable when its mappable fraction is strictly greater than this value.

ref_path

Character scalar. Path to the reference genome FASTA (requires Biostrings). Sequence names may be with or without the "chr" prefix.

BPPARAM

A BiocParallel::BiocParallelParam; GC content is computed per chromosome in parallel. We used BiocParallel::MulticoreParam(workers = 8L).

verbose

Logical; print progress messages. Default FALSE.

Value

genome_bins with added metadata columns:

bin_id

character, "<chr>-<start>-<end>".

gc_frequency

numeric GC fraction in [0, 1] (NA for windows outside the reference).

mappability

numeric mappable fraction in [0, 1].

is_mappable

logical, mappability > window_prop.

If no mappability interval survives chromosome filtering or the th threshold, the column frac_mappable = 0 is added instead of mappability and all windows are is_mappable = FALSE.

Details

A base is counted as mappable when it lies in an interval with score >= th; the mappable fraction of a window is the number of such bases divided by the window width, and is_mappable is mappability > window_prop (strictly greater).

Examples

if (requireNamespace("Biostrings", quietly = TRUE)) {
  fa <- tempfile(fileext = ".fa")
  seqs <- Biostrings::DNAStringSet(c(
    chr1 = paste(rep("ACGTGGCCAT", 100), collapse = "")
  ))
  Biostrings::writeXStringSet(seqs, fa)
  si <- GenomeInfoDb::Seqinfo("chr1", 1000L)
  bins <- make_fixed_bins(si, 200L, use_chr = 1)
  map <- GenomicRanges::GRanges("chr1", IRanges::IRanges(c(1, 501), c(500, 1000)),
                                score = c(1, 0.5))
  GenomeInfoDb::seqinfo(map) <- si
  compute_bin_mappability(bins, map, ref_path = fa)
}
#> GRanges object with 5 ranges and 4 metadata columns:
#>       seqnames    ranges strand |        bin_id gc_frequency mappability
#>          <Rle> <IRanges>  <Rle> |   <character>    <numeric>   <numeric>
#>   [1]     chr1     1-200      * |    chr1-1-200          0.6         1.0
#>   [2]     chr1   201-400      * |  chr1-201-400          0.6         1.0
#>   [3]     chr1   401-600      * |  chr1-401-600          0.6         0.5
#>   [4]     chr1   601-800      * |  chr1-601-800          0.6         0.0
#>   [5]     chr1  801-1000      * | chr1-801-1000          0.6         0.0
#>       is_mappable
#>         <logical>
#>   [1]        TRUE
#>   [2]        TRUE
#>   [3]       FALSE
#>   [4]       FALSE
#>   [5]       FALSE
#>   -------
#>   seqinfo: 1 sequence from an unspecified genome
